title: Operation Jackpot
subtitle: Naval commandos strike ports and waterways during the Liberation War.
summary: On 15 August 1971, Bengali naval commandos launched simultaneous sabotage attacks at major river and sea ports, including Chittagong, Mongla, Chandpur, and Narayanganj. The operation disrupted Pakistani waterway communication and became a celebrated naval chapter of the war.
heroTagline: Naval commandos strike ports and waterways during the Liberation War.
whyItMatters: Operation Jackpot adds asymmetric naval warfare to the Liberation War narrative.
